name: Banh xiu pao
summary: Bánh xíu páo is a small baked bun. Dân Việt fills it with diced xá xíu, fat, wood-ear, and half a boiled quail egg. VnExpress fills it with pork loin fried with garlic, five spice, oyster sauce, and honey. Both fillings stay. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định. VnExpress on 18 March 2016 calls it a Hoa snack from the old phố Khách, now Hoàng Văn Thụ and Lê Hồng Phong. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 places the afternoon walk on Lê Hồng Phong, Trần Hưng Đạo, Hàng Sắt, Bắc Ninh, and Lý Thường Kiệt.
texture: VnExpress says the skin is thin like a baked cake, softer and more fragrant, and can be peeled in thin layers. Dân Việt says it looks like a small baked bao, with a filling like a baked mooncake.
taste: Dân Việt: fragrant xá xíu, rich fat, and the heat of pepper, eaten hot. VnExpress: the loin is fried to a brown, fragrant color. Thế giới tiếp thị on 12 September 2022 repeats both the loin method and the hot xá xíu, fat, and pepper. All stay.
howToEat: Hot. Dân Việt says afternoon. VnExpress calls it a morning snack for schoolchildren. Thế giới tiếp thị says morning or afternoon. All three stay. A price is Check on arrival. A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Lê Hồng Phong, Trần Hưng Đạo, Hàng Sắt, Bắc Ninh, and Lý Thường Kiệt on the September 2025 walk. Hoàng Văn Thụ and Lê Hồng Phong on the 2016 account, as the old phố Khách. Both street lists stay.
seoTitle: Banh xiu pao — Nam Dinh’s small baked bun
seoDescription: A small baked bun. One account fills it with xá xíu and quail egg. Another fries pork loin with five spice. Afternoon and morning both stay. A price is Check on arrival.
